mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_profile WHERE class_id = #{classId}) as totalStudents, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM ai_training_plans WHERE class_id = CAST(#{classId} AS UNSIGNED) AND review_status = '待定') as pendingReviewCount, (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(approved * 100.0 / cnt) END FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) as cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN review_status = '批准' AND progress >= 100 THEN student_id END) as approved FROM ai_training_plans WHERE class_id = CAST(#{classId} AS UNSIGNED) ) t ) as completionRate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT ss.student_id FROM shuttlecock_skills ss JOIN student_profile sp ON ss.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = #{classId} AND ss.personal_score < 70 GROUP BY ss.student_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 UNION SELECT atp.student_id FROM ai_training_plans atp WHERE atp.class_id = CAST(#{classId} AS UNSIGNED) AND atp.progress < 60 AND atp.review_status != '待定' ) t ) as needAttentionCount

SELECT t.id, t.real_name as name, t.reason FROM ( -- 分支 1：薄弱项≥2 的学生 SELECT sp.id, sp.real_name, CONCAT(COUNT(ss.skill_type), '项动作薄弱(', GROUP_CONCAT(ss.skill_type SEPARATOR '、'), ')') as reason, 1 as sort_order FROM student_profile sp INNER JOIN shuttlecock_skills ss ON ss.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = #{classId} AND ss.personal_score < 70 GROUP BY sp.id, sp.real_name HAVING COUNT(ss.skill_type) >= 2
UNION
-- 分支 2：进度<60%且已有计划的学生（排除已在分支 1 中的） SELECT sp.id, sp.real_name, CONCAT('训练进度仅', atp.progress, '%') as reason, 2 as sort_order FROM student_profile sp INNER JOIN ai_training_plans atp ON atp.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = #{classId} AND atp.progress < 60 AND atp.review_status != '待定' AND atp.class_id = CAST(#{classId} AS UNSIGNED) AND sp.id NOT IN ( SELECT ssp.id FROM student_profile ssp INNER JOIN shuttlecock_skills sss ON sss.student_id = ssp.id WHERE ssp.class_id = #{classId} AND sss.personal_score < 70 GROUP BY ssp.id HAVING COUNT(sss.skill_type) >= 2 ) ) t ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.id LIMIT 3

SELECT sp.id, sp.real_name as name, sp.student_id as studentId, COALESCE(atp.planStatus, 'pending') as planStatus, COALESCE(weak_list, '') as weakness, COALESCE(atp.progress, 0) as progress FROM student_profile sp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT student_id, CASE WHEN review_status = '待定' THEN 'pending' WHEN review_status = '批准' AND progress >= 100 THEN 'completed' ELSE 'progress' END as planStatus, progress FROM ai_training_plans WHERE class_id = CAST(#{classId} AS UNSIGNED) AND id = ( SELECT MAX(sub.id) FROM ai_training_plans sub WHERE sub.student_id = ai_training_plans.student_id AND sub.class_id = CAST(#{classId} AS UNSIGNED) ) ) atp ON atp.student_id = sp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT student_id, GROUP_CONCAT(skill_type SEPARATOR ',') as weak_list FROM shuttlecock_skills WHERE personal_score < 70 GROUP BY student_id ) ss ON ss.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = #{classId} AND (#{keyword} IS NULL OR #{keyword} = '' OR sp.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY sp.id

SELECT id, goal, tasks as tasksJson, progress, CASE review_status WHEN '待定' THEN 'pending' WHEN '批准' THEN 'approved' WHEN '驳回' THEN 'rejected' END as reviewStatus, review_comment as reviewComment, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as generatedAt FROM ai_training_plans WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, goal, tasks as tasksJson, progress, COALESCE(week_number, 1) as weekNumber, COALESCE(total_weeks, 1) as totalWeeks, full_plan_json as fullPlanJson, CASE review_status WHEN '待定' THEN 'pending' WHEN '批准' THEN 'approved' WHEN '驳回' THEN 'rejected' END as reviewStatus, review_comment as reviewComment, CASE WHEN week_start_date IS NOT NULL AND week_start_date != '0000-00-00' THEN DATE_FORMAT(week_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') END as weekStart, CASE WHEN week_end_date IS NOT NULL AND week_end_date != '0000-00-00' THEN DATE_FORMAT(week_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(created_at, INTERVAL 6 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') END as weekEnd, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as generatedAt FROM ai_training_plans WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND ( (week_start_date IS NOT NULL AND week_start_date != '0000-00-00' AND week_start_date <= CURDATE() AND week_end_date >= CURDATE()) OR (week_start_date IS NULL OR week_start_date = '0000-00-00') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN week_start_date IS NOT NULL AND week_start_date != '0000-00-00' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, week_number ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, goal, tasks as tasksJson, progress, COALESCE(week_number, 1) as weekNumber, COALESCE(total_weeks, 1) as totalWeeks, full_plan_json as fullPlanJson, CASE review_status WHEN '待定' THEN 'pending' WHEN '批准' THEN 'approved' WHEN '驳回' THEN 'rejected' END as reviewStatus, review_comment as reviewComment, CASE WHEN week_start_date IS NOT NULL AND week_start_date != '0000-00-00' THEN DATE_FORMAT(week_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') END as weekStart, CASE WHEN week_end_date IS NOT NULL AND week_end_date != '0000-00-00' THEN DATE_FORMAT(week_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(created_at, INTERVAL 6 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') END as weekEnd, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as generatedAt FROM ai_training_plans WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND (week_number = #{weekNumber} OR (week_number IS NULL AND #{weekNumber} = 1)) LIMIT 1

SELECT id, week_number as weekNumber, total_weeks as totalWeeks, goal, week_start_date as weekStart, week_end_date as weekEnd, progress, CASE review_status WHEN '待定' THEN 'pending' WHEN '批准' THEN 'approved' WHEN '驳回' THEN 'rejected' END as reviewStatus, full_plan_json as fullPlanJson, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as createdAt FROM ai_training_plans WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY week_start_date DESC, week_number ASC

SELECT MIN(id) as planGroupId, student_id as studentId, total_weeks as totalWeeks, MIN(goal) as overallGoal, MIN(created_at) as createdAt, COUNT(*) as weekCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT week_number ORDER BY week_number) as weekNumbers, SUM(CASE WHEN review_status = '批准' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN review_status = '待定' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingCount FROM ai_training_plans WHERE student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY student_id, total_weeks, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY createdAt DESC

INSERT INTO ai_training_plans ( student_id, class_id, goal, tasks, progress, review_status, week_start_date, week_end_date, week_number, total_weeks, full_plan_json, plan_source ) VALUES
( #{item.studentId}, #{item.classId}, #{item.goal}, #{item.tasks}, 0, '待定', #{item.weekStartDate}, #{item.weekEndDate}, #{item.weekNumber}, #{item.totalWeeks}, #{item.fullPlanJson}, 'ai' )
